0.long_answer: The autosomal-recessive metabolic disorder is Combined Malonic and Methylmalonic Aciduria (CMAMMA). It is caused by a deficiency in the mitochondrial enzyme ACSF3, which normally catalyzes the formation of a thioester bond between fatty acids and coenzyme A. This disorder is distinguished from classic methylmalonic acidemia by the unique ratio of methylmalonic acid to malonic acid in blood plasma.
